task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Lift the medium black mug with handle, turn it, place it back, and move it onto the rack with two rods sticking out with the right arm.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架将带手柄的中号黑色马克杯提起，转动，放回，用右臂伸出的两根杆将其移动到架子上。
